stage.name: Peak of Carnival
stage.description:
'Did you know about the secret Self-Driver Hell Trail? Don't cry when you get hit!'
<Special Condition>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Self-Driving Cart Launchpoint> Spend DP to activate and launch a Self-Driving Cart
<Self-Driver One-Way Road> Causes Self-Driving Carts to turn when they pass over it

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.name: Originium Slug β
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than an Originium Slug α. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

alcohol_association_member.name: Alcohol Association Member
alcohol_association_member.flavourText: A piss-drunk Durin. 'I'm not drunk! Who said I was drunk? Was it you?!'
abilities: Initially has 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

alcohol_lover.name: Alcohol Lover
alcohol_lover.flavourText: A somewhat tipsy Durin. Just inebriated enough to think they're battling against some evil creature.
abilities: Initially has 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

lakeside_lifeguard.name: Lakeside Lifeguard
lakeside_lifeguard.flavourText: A professional lifeguard who goes around shooting the breeze. Strong in stature and bronzed in complexion, one look at him is enough to give a sense of security. But in actuality, he can't swim at all, and got that tan from high-intensity outdoor boxing training.
abilities: Upon dropping below half HP for the first time, gains 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

volleyball_serving_cart.name: Volleyball Serving Cart
volleyball_serving_cart.flavourText: A volleyball-serving cart designed for use by friendless tourists. However, they see no use at all, as there are far too many people coming to play volleyball.
abilities: Gains increased ATK with each attack (up to a limit); when affected by certain Negative Statuses, these stacks will be lost

lakeside_volunteer.name: Lakeside Volunteer
lakeside_volunteer.flavourText: An amateur lifeguard doing nothing in particular. Because there really was nobody in need of saving, he instead decided to take up boxing, and unexpectedly had quite the talent for it.
abilities: Upon dropping below half HP for the first time, gains 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

volleyball_spiking_cart.name: Volleyball Spiking Cart
volleyball_spiking_cart.flavourText: A volleyball-spiking cart designed as a revenge against someone. Continuously makes powerful spikes at nearby people in an attempt to ruin all volleyball matches on the beach.
abilities: Gains increased ATK with each attack (up to a limit); when affected by certain Negative Statuses, these stacks will be lost

infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.name: Infused Originium Slug α
infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen, exploding upon death. More dangerous than a normal Infused Originium Slug. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units

sandcastle_builder.name: Sandcastle Builder
sandcastle_builder.flavourText: A Durin who has made a hobby out of building sandcastles. He despises those who would kick up the waters of the artificial lake, and so he installed an Arts Unit onto his construction tool.

sandcastle_architect.name: Sandcastle Architect
sandcastle_architect.flavourText: A Durin who has made a career out of designing sandcastles. Having accepted the reality that it is impossible to actually build a sandcastle, he has not even been drafting designs recently, instead focusing his efforts on tinkering with the Arts Unit.

mead_grade_waker_upper.name: Mead-Grade Waker-Upper
mead_grade_waker_upper.flavourText: A powerful machine that sends chills across the beach with its might, providing a complimentary water cannon service for drunkards by the lake. The only downside being that it has no way of actually identifying who is drunk.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time, gains significantly increased ASPD and Movement Speed for a period of time

full_metal_surfing_instructor.name: Full Metal Surfing Instructor
full_metal_surfing_instructor.flavourText: A sturdy mechanical surfing instructor that can withstand strong winds and waves. Its weaknesses are twofold: despite its anti-rust coating, it still rusts easily, and also it doesn't float.
abilities: When not blocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced

alloy_surfing_instructor.name: Alloy Surfing Instructor
alloy_surfing_instructor.flavourText: A sturdy mechanical surfing instructor that can withstand water and corrosion. High-density rare alloys were incorporated to increase its resistance to rust, but as such, it sinks even harder.
abilities: When not blocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced

whiskey_grade_waker_upper.name: Whiskey-Grade Waker-Upper
whiskey_grade_waker_upper.flavourText: A terrifying machine that sweeps across the beach, equipped with an ultra-powerful water cannon strong enough to blast any drunkard to their senses. After someone secretly tampered with its targeting logic, it now only blasts sober people.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time, gains significantly increased ASPD and Movement Speed for a period of time

fully_enclosed_beach_buggy.name: Fully-Enclosed Beach Buggy
fully_enclosed_beach_buggy.flavourText: A beach buggy beloved by all. Carries three passengers in addition to the driver. Cool and breezy on the inside, it's perfect for those tuckered out from playing.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 3 max), and will be unloaded when this unit is defeated

competitive_grade_beach_buggy.name: Competitive-Grade Beach Buggy
competitive_grade_beach_buggy.flavourText: A beach buggy beloved by all. Though its capacity is the same, all its other peripherals have been upgraded - in particular, the AC unit that effortlessly makes driver and passengers alike shiver.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 3 max), and will be unloaded when this unit is defeated
